title: Everyday Phrases — Sightseeing Bus Tour
scene_zh: 觀光巴士 · 情境對話
title_quote: Is this the sightseeing bus desk?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🚌 實用觀光巴士必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Sightseeing Bus Tour
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用觀光巴士情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從售票台買一日票、問路線與末班車、領語音導覽耳機，到登上上層找座位、沿途聽講解、下車拍照買紀念品、再改搭另一條線，最後搭日落末班車、寫評價、轉乘接駁車回飯店，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Sightseeing Bus Tour phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering buying a day pass at the ticket desk, asking about routes and the last bus, picking up the audio guide, finding a seat on the open top deck, listening to the commentary, hopping off for photos and souvenirs, transferring to another line, then the sunset ride, leaving a review and the shuttle back to the hotel. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the sightseeing bus desk?
dialogue.zh: 這裡是觀光巴士的售票台嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, right here at the corner.
dialogue.zh: 對，就在這個角落的櫃台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want a bus pass for today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt ə bʌs pæs fər təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我想買一張今天的巴士票。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have one-day and two-day passes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv wʌn deɪ ænd tu deɪ ˈpæsɪz./
dialogue.zh: 我們有一日票和兩日票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which pass is better for me?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One day is enough for the center.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn deɪ ɪz ɪˈnʌf fər ðə ˈsɛntər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the one-day pass?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðə wʌn deɪ pæs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is thirty euros for one adult.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈθɜrti ˈjʊroʊz fər wʌn əˈdʌlt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that include every stop?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, both routes and all stops.
dialogue.zh: 是的，兩條路線和所有站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I hop off and back on again?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ hɑp ɔf ænd bæk ɑn əˈɡɛn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, that is the whole idea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs, ðæt ɪz ðə hoʊl aɪˈdiə./
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，這就是它的設計。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a student discount here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show your card and save four euros.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ jʊr kɑrd ænd seɪv fɔr ˈjʊroʊz./
dialogue.zh: 出示證件就能省四歐元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about my son, is he free?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt maɪ sʌn, ɪz hi fri?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids under thirteen ride free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is really good news.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can also buy a night tour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn ˈɔlsoʊ baɪ ə naɪt tʊr./
dialogue.zh: 你們也可以買夜間遊票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is special about the night tour?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ˈspɛʃəl əˈbaʊt ðə naɪt tʊr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bridges are all lit up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We will save that for our next trip.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl seɪv ðæt fər ˈaʊər nɛkst trɪp./
dialogue.zh: 我們把這個留到下次旅行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart choice, the sunset is best.
dialogue.zh: 聰明的選擇，日落時最美。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need my passport to buy?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid maɪ ˈpæspɔrt tu baɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just cash or a card.
dialogue.zh: 不用，現金或刷卡都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or can I just tap my watch?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr kæn aɪ dʒʌst tæp maɪ wɑtʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 還是說我直接用手錶感應？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tap right on this machine.
dialogue.zh: 可以，在這台機器上點一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tap did not work.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the card in the slot again.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə kɑrd ɪn ðə slɑt əˈɡɛn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, that worked this time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now take your two printed tickets.
dialogue.zh: 現在拿好這兩張列印好的票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I keep these paper slips?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep them till you reach the hotel.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðɛm tɪl ju ritʃ ði hoʊˈtɛl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do the buses actually start?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From the big square, two blocks away.
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌm ðə bɪɡ skwɛr, tu blɑks əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 從兩個街區外的大廣場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that square hard to find?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow the flags on the pole.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which route should we take first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Red goes west, blue goes east.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the red route pass the museum?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə rɛd rut pæs ðə mjuˈziəm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and it stops right outside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is one full loop?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About ninety minutes without hopping.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will we see the old castle too?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl wi si ðə oʊld ˈkæsəl tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the bus parks near its gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə bʌs parks nɪr ɪts ɡeɪt./
dialogue.zh: 會，巴士就停在城門附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the boats part of this ticket?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə boʊts pɑrt əv ðɪs ˈtɪkɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 遊船也包含在這張票裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the boat costs extra money.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will skip the boat for now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl skɪp ðə boʊt fər naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, you already have a full day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ju ɔlˈrɛdi hæv ə fʊl deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 好，你這一天已經排滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time is your last departure?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The final bus leaves at eight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do buses run when it rains?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the roof has a cover.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a place to leave my bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə pleɪs tu liv maɪ bæɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 有地方寄存我的行李嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask the shop beside the desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell maps of the route?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju sɛl mæps əv ðə rut?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take one free from that rack.
dialogue.zh: 從那個架子上免費拿一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This map shows only one route.
dialogue.zh: 這張地圖只畫了一條線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it over, blue is behind.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I hear the audio guide?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr kæn aɪ hɪr ði ˈɑdiˌoʊ ɡaɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 我在哪裡能聽語音導覽？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Headphones are on the bus itself.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are those headphones in many languages?
dialogue.zh: 那些耳機有很多種語言嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There are eight, including Chinese.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My English is a little slow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then take the slow English one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which stop is closest to our hotel?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ stɑp ɪz ˈkloʊsɪst tu ˈaʊər hoʊˈtɛl?/
dialogue.zh: 哪一站離我們飯店最近？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check your booking screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, the hotel name is River View.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, ðə hoʊˈtɛl neɪm ɪz ˈrɪvər vju./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then stop eleven is closest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that stop on the red route?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt stɑp ɑn ðə rɛd rut?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, wait for a blue bus.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I can switch buses for free?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ kæn swɪtʃ ˈbʌsəz fər fri?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, show the same pass again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I have to book a seat online?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ hæv tu bʊk ə sit ˌɑnˈlaɪn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, any seat is fine here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I sit anywhere on the top?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ sɪt ˈɛniˌwɛr ɑn ðə tɑp?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, go up the front stairs.
dialogue.zh: 可以，走前面的樓梯上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the seats numbered at all?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: None, it is all open seating.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do groups have to reserve ahead?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only for parties over fifteen.
dialogue.zh: 超過十五人的團體才要預約。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are just a family of three.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑr dʒʌst ə ˈfæməli əv θri./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then no paperwork at all.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get a refund if it rains?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt ə ˈriˌfənd ɪf ɪt reɪnz?/
dialogue.zh: 如果下雨我可以退票嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only before the first ride.
dialogue.zh: 只有在第一次乘車前才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if I use only half of it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf aɪ juz ˈoʊnli hæf əv ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then no money comes back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough, I will keep the pass.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr ɪˈnʌf, aɪ wɪl kip ðə pæs./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will use it, trust me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I find the stamp card?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ faɪnd ðə stæmp kɑrd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is no card, just stamps.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stamps? Where would I find those?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Each main stop keeps one inside.
dialogue.zh: 每個主站裡面都放了一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds like fun for my son.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt saʊndz laɪk fʌn fər maɪ sʌn./
dialogue.zh: 這對我兒子來說很好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Boys love collecting them all.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a ticket for the tower?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ə ˈtɪkɪt fər ðə ˈtaʊər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I can add it right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, aɪ kæn æd ɪt raɪt naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much extra does that cost?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight euros with your bus pass.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, add one for the tower.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go, have a great trip.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ju ɡoʊ, hæv ə ɡreɪt trɪp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，這個座位有人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is all yours.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Come up slowly, the stairs are steep.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm ʌp ˈsloʊli, ðə stɛrz ɑr stip./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have the rail, do not worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ðə reɪl, du nɑt ˈwɜri./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, the whole city is below us.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ, ðə hoʊl ˈsɪti ɪz bɪˈloʊ ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 哇，整個城市在我們腳下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This is why I ride up here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz waɪ aɪ raɪd ʌp hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 這就是我愛坐上層的原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wind is really strong today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold on to your hat tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, I almost lost it once.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hat flies off every other day.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn hæt flaɪz ɑf ˈɛvri ˈʌðər deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 每隔一天就會有一頂帽子被吹走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need these headphones?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the guide speaks through them.
dialogue.zh: 需要，導覽聲音從那裡傳來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which number is English here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the button marked two.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hear music, not a voice.
dialogue.zh: 我聽到音樂，卻沒有人聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try again, it starts in seconds.
dialogue.zh: 再按一次，幾秒後就開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now a woman is speaking softly.
dialogue.zh: 現在有一位女士在輕輕地說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's our guide for this route.
dialogue.zh: 那就是我們這條線的導覽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She says we turn left soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look left, there is the stone arch.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk lɛft, ðɛr ɪz ðə stoʊn ɑrtʃ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that the old city gate?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is four hundred years old.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt ɪz fɔr ˈhʌndrəd jɪrz oʊld./
dialogue.zh: 對，它已經有四百年的歷史。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can't see well from here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move to the front row, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it okay to stand for photos?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt oʊˈkeɪ tu stænd fər ˈfoʊtoʊz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only when the bus is stopped.
dialogue.zh: 只有在完全停下時才可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bus is moving again now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit down, that is the rule.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, I didn't know that.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我不知道這條規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, everyone forgets.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, red roofs everywhere.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the old market area.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My camera is almost full.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Delete some old photos first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you take a photo of us?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju teɪk ə ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ʌs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, hold your son's hand.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，把你兒子的手牽好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more, with the tower behind.
dialogue.zh: 再一張，以那座塔當背景。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say eggplant and hold still.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one came out great.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll send it to you tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The guide says look to the right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡaɪd sɛz lʊk tu ðə raɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, a huge white palace!
dialogue.zh: 哇，一座巨大的白色宮殿！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do people still live there?
dialogue.zh: 現在還有人住在那裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is a museum now.
dialogue.zh: 沒有了，它現在是博物館。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should get off at that stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ʃʊd ɡɛt ɔf æt ðæt stɑp./
dialogue.zh: 我們應該在那一站下車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the palace gardens are lovely.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I tell the driver?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the red bell button.
dialogue.zh: 按那個紅色的鈴鐺按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I ring it too early?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's fine, the next stop is close.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts faɪn, ðə nɛkst stɑp ɪz kloʊs./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rain is coming, let's stay on.
dialogue.zh: 雨要來了，我們就留在車上吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope it holds off a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp ɪt hoʊldz ɔf ə ˈlɪtəl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a small umbrella?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, but the stop sells them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some drops are falling already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The roof cover is coming down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, now we stay dry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can still see the view.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This rain smells so fresh.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I love the city in the rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv ðə ˈsɪti ɪn ðə reɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A couple moved up here too.
dialogue.zh: 一對夫妻也坐到上層了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They seem to be on holiday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry to ask, but where from?
dialogue.zh: 冒昧問一下，你們從哪裡來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We came from Canada this week.
dialogue.zh: 我們這週剛從加拿大來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Canada is very far away.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, eleven hours by plane.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you ride these buses at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju raɪd ðiz ˈbʌsəz æt hoʊm?/
dialogue.zh: 你們家鄉也坐這種巴士嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, this is our first time.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，這是我們第一次坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do you stay in town?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ du ju steɪ ɪn taʊn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five nights, then we fly home.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a perfect amount.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We packed every single day.
dialogue.zh: 我們把每一天都排滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bell rang, this is our stop!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛl ræŋ, ðɪs ɪz ˈaʊər stɑp!/
dialogue.zh: 鈴響了，這是我們要下的站！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go down the back stairs slowly.
dialogue.zh: 從後面的樓梯慢慢走下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we wait right here after?
dialogue.zh: 之後我們就在這裡等嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the pole shows your line.
dialogue.zh: 對，站牌會顯示你的路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for helping me today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, the ride was fun.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the bus always this friendly?
dialogue.zh: 這巴士上總是這麼親切嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Travelers talk to travelers here.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡旅客會互相聊天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here comes the red bus now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hop on, the guide names a square.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑp ɑn, ðə ɡaɪd neɪmz ə skwɛr./
dialogue.zh: 快上車，導覽正在講一個廣場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She says that square hosts a fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz ðæt skwɛr hoʊsts ə fɛr./
dialogue.zh: 她說那個廣場會辦市集。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and they sell warm chestnuts.
dialogue.zh: 對，那裡在賣熱騰騰的栗子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son loves roasted chestnuts.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then get off at the fair stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɡɛt ɔf æt ðə fɛr stɑp./
dialogue.zh: 那我們就到市集站下車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many stops until the fair?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three more, about ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bus is climbing a hill.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From the top you see everything.
dialogue.zh: 到了坡頂什麼都看得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel like I am flying.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep your arms inside, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, I get too excited.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's okay, I did the same.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a river down there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Boats cross it all day long.
dialogue.zh: 船整天在河上來來往往。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This trip is worth the money.
dialogue.zh: 這趟旅行真對得起票價。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell that at the ticket desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our stop is coming up now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get your bags and stand up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, here are the warm chestnuts!
dialogue.zh: 你看，熱騰騰的栗子就在這裡！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two paper bags, then we board.
dialogue.zh: 買兩袋，然後我們再上車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we wait for the next bus?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du wi weɪt fər ðə nɛkst bʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要在哪裡等下一班？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At this same pole, see the sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt ðɪs seɪm poʊl, si ðə saɪn./
dialogue.zh: 就在同一支站牌，看那塊牌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the right pole for red buses?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ðə raɪt poʊl fər rɛd ˈbʌsəz?/
dialogue.zh: 紅線巴士是在這支牌等嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the red one stops right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə rɛd wʌn stɑps raɪt hɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I know a bus is coming?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ noʊ ə bʌs ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 我怎麼知道車子要來了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It flashes its number as it nears.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈflæʃəz ɪts ˈnʌmbər æz ɪt nɪrz./
dialogue.zh: 它靠近時會先閃出車號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I show my pass again here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ʃoʊ maɪ pæs əˈɡɛn hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡我還是要出示票嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the driver checks it.
dialogue.zh: 是的，司機會檢查你的票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I leave my bag on the bus?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ liv maɪ bæɡ ɑn ðə bʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把袋子留在車上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, take everything with you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This bridge looks great in photos.
dialogue.zh: 這座橋拍照看起來很棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand under the old lamp.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my hat straight enough?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tilt it a little to the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɪlt ɪt ə ˈlɪtəl tu ðə lɛft./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, now count to three.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One, two, three, got it!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I look surprised in every photo.
dialogue.zh: 我每張照片看起來都很吃驚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is normal for tourists.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the gift shop inside?
dialogue.zh: 裡面的紀念品店在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Up the stairs, then left again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they sell small postcards here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two for one euro.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will write to my sister.
dialogue.zh: 我要寫一張給我的姊姊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a mailbox by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈmeɪlˌbɑks baɪ ðə dɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the line to climb very long?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə laɪn tu klaɪm ˈvɛri lɔŋ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About twenty minutes, I think.
dialogue.zh: 我想大約要等二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can skip it and walk around.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn skɪp ɪt ænd wɔk əˈraʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 我們可以先不爬，先在附近走走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The view from up there is worth it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə vju frʌm ʌp ðɛr ɪz wɜrθ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不過上面的風景真的很值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, we climb it after coffee.
dialogue.zh: 好，我們喝完咖啡再去爬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, my legs need a break.
dialogue.zh: 成交，我的腿也需要休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That coffee smell came from here.
dialogue.zh: 那股咖啡香是從這裡飄來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's buy something warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two cookies and one hot chocolate.
dialogue.zh: 兩塊餅乾和一杯熱可可。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That will be nine euros.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you take card payments?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cards are fine, tap here.
dialogue.zh: 刷卡也可以，在這裡點一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These cookies are really good.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save one for your son.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He fell asleep on my shoulder.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let him sleep, we can wait.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, that bus just left!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The next one comes in ten.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I don't want to lose our spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ doʊnt wɑnt tu luz ˈaʊər spɑt./
dialogue.zh: 我不想失去我們的位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seats are free, don't worry.
dialogue.zh: 座位是隨便坐的，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we take the blue line now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi teɪk ðə blu laɪn naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們現在改坐藍線好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it goes to the harbor.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the blue bus stop?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Across the street, past the fountain.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it on the same ticket?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same ticket, don't buy twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, that saves some money.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blue bus has fewer people.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it comes, get ready.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's sit in the back this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts sɪt ɪn ðə bæk ðɪs taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 這次我們坐最後面好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The harbor air smells salty.
dialogue.zh: 碼頭空氣聞起來鹹鹹的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe deep, it's good for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can see boats loading boxes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They bring fruit from far away.
dialogue.zh: 他們從很遠的地方運水果來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the guide talk about ships?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She names each old warehouse.
dialogue.zh: 她會一一說出舊倉庫的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That red one is very famous.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A famous painter lived there.
dialogue.zh: 有位有名畫家住過那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saw her face on a mug.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɔ hɜr feɪs ɑn ə mʌɡ./
dialogue.zh: 我在馬克杯上看過她的臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shop sells them at the corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɑp sɛlz ðɛm æt ðə ˈkɔrnər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's buy that red building mug.
dialogue.zh: 我們買那款紅房子杯子吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll take one for my desk too.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl teɪk wʌn fər maɪ dɛsk tu./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for two small mugs?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six euros, and I'll pack them.
dialogue.zh: 六歐元，我幫你們包起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a bag for that?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ə bæɡ fər ðæt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, this paper one is free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want a magnet for my mom.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt ə ˈmæɡnət fər maɪ mɑm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There are magnets on that shelf.
dialogue.zh: 那個架子上就有很多磁鐵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which one shows the harbor?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blue one with two sails.
dialogue.zh: 那張有兩面帆的藍色款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one is perfect, I'll take it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ɪz ˈpɜrfɪkt, aɪl teɪk ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it in your jacket pocket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're back on the bus again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scan your pass at the machine.
dialogue.zh: 在讀卡機上掃一下你的票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The light turned green, we're in.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, now pick a side to sit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, naʊ pɪk ə saɪd tu sɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want the left side for the water.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt ðə lɛft saɪd fər ðə ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 我要坐左邊，可以看到水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left is better on this route.
dialogue.zh: 這條線確實坐左邊比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The guide says the tour is half done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡaɪd sɛz ðə tʊr ɪz hæf dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 導覽說行程已經過一半了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Time went fast on this bus.
dialogue.zh: 在這台車上時間過得好快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that tall tower a hotel now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt tɔl ˈtaʊər ə hoʊˈtɛl naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 那座高塔現在是飯店嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you can sleep up there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I would love a room with that view.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd lʌv ə rum wɪð ðæt vju./
dialogue.zh: 我好想住一間那樣的房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It costs a lot, though.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe next time, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can dream from this seat.
dialogue.zh: 坐在這裡也可以作夢啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bus stops at the market now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bʌs stɑps æt ðə ˈmɑrkɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 巴士現在在市場站停了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smell that? It's grilled fish.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we eat there and still catch a bus?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi it ðɛr ænd stɪl kætʃ ə bʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 我們在那裡吃完還趕得上車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it's only five minutes in.
dialogue.zh: 可以，走進去只要五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's share one plate of fish.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And two lemon teas, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was the best bite today.
dialogue.zh: 那是今天最好吃的一口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our bus is leaving in eight.
dialogue.zh: 我們的巴士八分鐘後開走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sky is turning gold now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This is the best light for photos.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz ðə bɛst laɪt fər ˈfoʊtoʊz./
dialogue.zh: 這是最適合拍照的光線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the last bus tonight?
dialogue.zh: 這是今晚的最後一班嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it ends at the main desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt ɛndz æt ðə meɪn dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 對，終點就在售票台那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We made it, what good luck!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come up, two seats are open.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The street lights just came on.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The whole city starts to shine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the bridge is all pink.
dialogue.zh: 你看，那座橋全變粉紅了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone is holding up a phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm putting mine away for once.
dialogue.zh: 這一次我先把手機收起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, just watch it with your eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, dʒʌst wɑtʃ ɪt wɪð jʊr aɪz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The guide is speaking more softly.
dialogue.zh: 導覽的聲音變得更輕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She lets the night do the work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi lɛts ðə naɪt du ðə wɜrk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This was my favorite part today.
dialogue.zh: 今天是我最喜歡的一段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, I came here last year.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tu, aɪ keɪm hɪr læst jɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you do this tour every year?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju du ðɪs tʊr ˈɛvri jɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 你每年都來坐這條線嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once a year, always in autumn.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A staff member asked for our review.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə stæf ˈmɛmbər æskt fər ˈaʊər rɪˈvju./
dialogue.zh: 工作人員請我們寫評價。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can scan the code on your seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn skæn ðə koʊd ɑn jʊr sit./
dialogue.zh: 你可以掃座位上的那個條碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I write in English or Chinese?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ raɪt ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɔr tʃaɪˈniz?/
dialogue.zh: 我該用英文還是中文寫？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Either is fine, they translate them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I say in it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with what you liked most.
dialogue.zh: 先寫你最喜歡的那部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I liked the clear audio guide.
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡很清楚的語音導覽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will write about the friendly staff.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl raɪt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈfrɛndli stæf./
dialogue.zh: 我要寫工作人員很親切。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you like the bus ride?
dialogue.zh: 你喜歡這趟巴士之旅嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I loved it, five stars from me.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lʌvd ɪt, faɪv stɑrz frʌm mi./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything you would change?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: More shaded seats on the top.
dialogue.zh: 上層多一點有遮陰的座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And better signs at each stop?
dialogue.zh: 還有每站的牌子能不能更清楚？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the blue line signs are small.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə blu laɪn saɪnz ɑr smɔl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll note that in my review.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They really read every note.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get points for a review?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt pɔɪnts fər ə rɪˈvju?/
dialogue.zh: 寫評價可以拿到積分嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They send a coupon by email.
dialogue.zh: 他們會寄一張折價券到你信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My pass ends at this stop, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ pæs ɛndz æt ðɪs stɑp, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我的票到這站就結束了，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, show it one last time.
dialogue.zh: 對，最後再給司機看一下就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask about a refund now?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æsk əˈbaʊt ə ˈriˌfənd naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在可以問退票的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The desk stays open until ten.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I lost two hours in the rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lɔst tu ˈaʊərz ɪn ðə reɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我因為下雨損失了兩小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They may give you one more day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ meɪ ɡɪv ju wʌn mɔr deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 他們也許讓你多用一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is an extra day paid or free?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɛn ˈɛkstrə deɪ peɪd ɔr fri?/
dialogue.zh: 多出來那天要付錢還是免費？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's free if the weather caused it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts fri ɪf ðə ˈwɛðər kɔzd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 如果是天氣造成的就免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That would be so fair.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask them, show your wet ticket.
dialogue.zh: 去問問，把濕濕的票給他們看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the hotel shuttle tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚的飯店接駁車在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By the north door, blue van.
dialogue.zh: 在北門那裡，那台藍色小巴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it stop at River View Hotel?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪt stɑp æt ˈrɪvər vju hoʊˈtɛl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that is the second stop.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is the ride back there?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ ɪz ðə raɪd bæk ðɛr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes if traffic is light.
dialogue.zh: 路況順利的話二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there room for my small bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr rum fər maɪ smɔl bæɡ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, put it under the seat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I don't need a taxi tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我不需要搭計程車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Taxis are hard to catch now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That van looks warm and clean.
dialogue.zh: 那台小巴看起來又暖又乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect after a long day out.
dialogue.zh: 在外面跑一整天後剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My feet are killing me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit down, the bench is right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt daʊn, ðə bɛnʧ ɪz raɪt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 坐一下吧，長椅就在那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which part did you like most?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I liked the small streets best.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time I want the morning bus.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm aɪ wɑnt ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ bʌs./
dialogue.zh: 下次我想坐早上那一班。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's empty then, you get the front.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈɛmpti ðɛn, ju ɡɛt ðə frʌnt./
dialogue.zh: 那時車上很空，你能坐最前面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we buy tickets tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it closes at ten sharp.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two more day passes for tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is sixty euros for both.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card again, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, here are two new passes.
dialogue.zh: 好了，這是你們的兩張新票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need them before nine tomorrow?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ðɛm bɪˈfɔr naɪn təˈmɑroʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 明天九點以前就必須用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, use them any time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The driver waved at us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He remembers friendly faces.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We left one headphone on the bus.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi lɛft wʌn ˈhɛdˌfoʊn ɑn ðə bʌs./
dialogue.zh: 我們把一隻耳機落在車上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call the desk, they keep lost things.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl ðə dɛsk, ðeɪ kip lɔst θɪŋz./
dialogue.zh: 打給櫃台，他們保管遺失物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that phone number on my ticket?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt foʊn ˈnʌmbər ɑn maɪ ˈtɪkɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 那支電話號碼在我的票上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look at the bottom, small print.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, I'll call in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt, aɪl kɔl ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 找到了，我早上再打電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They answer from eight onward.
dialogue.zh: 他們八點之後就有人接。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow, the whole blue line then.
dialogue.zh: 明天就要把藍線整個坐完。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring water and your hat this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ˈwɔtər ænd jʊr hæt ðɪs taɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tour gave me good ideas.
dialogue.zh: 這趟導覽給了我很多想法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You saw so much in one day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju sɔ soʊ mʌtʃ ɪn wʌn deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 一天之內你就看了這麼多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much did the whole day cost?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dɪd ðə hoʊl deɪ kɔst?/
dialogue.zh: 這一天總共花了多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Around a hundred, with the snacks.
dialogue.zh: 加上點心大約一百歐元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is cheap for all of this.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz tʃip fər ɔl əv ðɪs./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell your sister that in your letter.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl jʊr ˈsɪstər ðæt ɪn jʊr ˈlɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 你在信裡也這樣跟你姊姊說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bus station is quiet now.
dialogue.zh: 巴士站現在安靜下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The last bus has gone home too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læst bʌs hæz ɡɔn hoʊm tu./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone is dead, so no photos.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn ɪz dɛd, soʊ noʊ ˈfoʊtoʊz./
dialogue.zh: 我手機沒電，拍不了照了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the pictures in your head.
dialogue.zh: 那就把畫面記在腦子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a nicer souvenir anyway.
dialogue.zh: 那反而是更好的紀念品。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Memories cost nothing at all.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for riding with us.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你們搭乘我們的路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, we had a great day.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju, wi hæd ə ɡreɪt deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 也要謝謝你，我們這天過得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you come back next spring?
dialogue.zh: 你們明年春天會再來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we'll book the night tour.
dialogue.zh: 會，我們要訂那個夜間遊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, sleep well after this.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, dream about buses.
